# Copilot Instructions

## General

- Use TypeScript.
- Prefer simple solutions.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Do not introduce abstractions without a concrete need.
- Keep components small and reusable.
- Do not use `any`.
- Do not modify unrelated files.

## Astro

- Prefer Astro components for static content.
- Use SSG.
- Do not enable SSR.
- Do not use React Router.
- Keep client-side JavaScript minimal.

## Styling

- Use Tailwind CSS.
- Use a mobile-first responsive approach.
- Keep spacing and typography consistent.

## Data

- products.json is the source of truth.
- Never hardcode products.
- Never hardcode brands.
- Do not change the products.json structure.
